text: I think you might enjoy this recipe for Tomato and Basil Sauce - Salsa Di Pomodoro E Basilico. It features fresh basil, which is a common ingredient in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The use of olive oil and garlic also aligns with your preferences. While this recipe does contain some sugar, the overall sugar content is relatively low compared to other recipes. The cooking time is also within your typical range, and the dish can be made in about 40 minutes.
